system.description:
Seeks out one kind of substance or object nearby (gold, water, a lost item...). Each kind is learned separately; a new version can be devised in double the time.

Spell. By distance: within 50 feet Routine (6), 100 feet Challenging (9), 500 feet Formidable (12), Hard (15), 2,000 feet Very Hard (18), one mile Heroic (21). More degrees mean a faster, surer trail, from a 10-yard search area at one degree to the exact spot at four.

Art of Divination — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 98.
